dedupe_keys.name: canalisation de transport de matieres dangereuses

description: Canalisation de transport de matières dangereuses is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bureau de Recherches Géologiques et Minières. Dictionnaire Public Ce jeu de données présente, sous la forme d'objets surfaciques, les canalisations de transport de matières dangereuses sur le territoire Girondin. Ce jeu de données est disponible dans un format additionnel: Téléchargement au format AutoCAD DWG. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are environnement, data-gouv, risque, nature, canalisations. The portal shows 398 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
